column1: # Campaign 28 Stage A client-go source evidence for txnkv-real-transaction-rpc-runtime.

column5: The normal optimistic primary commit request and determinate response path execute through the sole retained BatchCommands transport against a harness-owned real PD/TiKV cluster, with real PD TSO and route context plus immutable request, physical channel, and stream identity. Secondary/background commit, async commit, pipelined mode, region retry, lock resolution, and transaction-state orchestration remain open.

The normal optimistic Put prewrite and response path execute through the sole retained BatchCommands transport against a harness-owned real PD/TiKV cluster and are proved by both commit/readback and rollback/not-found flows. Async commit, one-phase commit, pessimistic actions, large transactions, TTL management, region retry, lock resolution, and transaction-state orchestration remain open.
